options.name: steps
options.description: The steps: { id, title, content?, target?, placement?, spotlightPadding?, onBeforeShow? }. target is an Element, a CSS selector, a function returning an Element, or null for a centered step.

options.name: dots
options.description: Show decorative progress dots under the content.

options.name: skippable
options.description: Show the Skip button (hidden on the last step).

options.name: keyboardNavigation
options.description: Arrow keys move between steps while focus is on the panel or its buttons (mirrored in RTL).

options.name: modal
options.description: Each step is a modal dialog: focus is trapped and the page is blocked.

options.name: spotlight
options.description: Dim the page around the target.

options.name: spotlightPadding
options.description: Space between the target and the spotlight edge, px (0 to 64).

options.name: locale
options.description: Locale of the button labels and progress text.

properties.name: host
properties.description: The host element (holds the overlay and panel).

properties.name: active
properties.description: True while a step is shown.

properties.name: index
properties.description: Index of the shown step, or -1 when inactive.

properties.name: target
properties.description: The element the current step points at (null for a centered step or when inactive).

methods.name: start
methods.description: Start (or restart) at index (default 0); steps with a missing target are skipped.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Show the next available step; on the last step, finish.

methods.name: goTo
methods.description: Show the step at index (starts the tour when inactive).

methods.name: skip
methods.description: End the tour early and emit aui-skip.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: End the tour as completed and emit aui-finish.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge and apply options; an active tour re-renders the current step.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: End the tour without events and remove rendering and listeners.

events.name: aui-start
events.description: The tour started: { index } of the first shown step.

events.name: aui-step-change
events.description: A step is shown: { index, stepId, previousIndex, direction }.

events.name: aui-step-missing
events.description: A step was skipped because its target is missing, hidden, or its hook failed: { index, stepId, reason }.

events.name: aui-finish
events.description: The tour ended at its end: { index, completed } (completed is false when no later step could be shown).

events.name: aui-skip
events.description: The tour was skipped: { index, stepId, reason }.

contentAreas.name: steps[].content
contentAreas.description: Step text, or a Node the application owns (inserted as given).

cssClasses.name: aui-tour--modal | --centered | --no-spotlight | --static
cssClasses.description: Modal steps, a step without a target, no spotlight, animation off.

cssClasses.name: aui-tour__overlay
cssClasses.description: Top-layer overlay that holds the spotlight (aria-hidden).

cssClasses.name: aui-tour__spotlight
cssClasses.description: Cut-out around the target; its shadow dims the page.

cssClasses.name: aui-tour__skip | __back | __next | __finish
cssClasses.description: The buttons (Next becomes Finish on the last step).
